findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_sticker_guidance" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: upload_sticker_artwork · Private data: get_sticker_guidance, upload_sticker_artwork · Public sink: get_sticker_guidance, upload_sticker_artwork · Destructive: upload_sticker_artwork, show_print_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: upload_sticker_artwork · Private data: get_sticker_guidance, upload_sticker_artwork · Public sink: get_sticker_guidance, upload_sticker_artwork · Destructive: upload_sticker_artwork, show_print_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
